license_required.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

issuing_authority.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

name.quote: the Board shall, in the interest of the public, judiciously: (a) Enforce the provisions of this chapter; (b) Establish by regulation standards for licensure under this chapter

type.quote: The purpose of licensing physicians, perfusionists, physician assistants, anesthesiologist assistants and practitioners of respiratory care is to protect the public health and safety and the general welfare of the people of this State.

moral_character_required.quote: a locum tenens license, to be effective not more than 3 months after issuance, to any physician who is licensed and in good standing in another state, who meets the requirements for licensure in this State and who is of good moral character and reputation.

degree_required.quote: Has received the degree of doctor of medicine from a medical school: (1) Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges; or (2) Which provides a course of professional instruction equivalent to that provided in medical schools in the United States approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME) of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges
accrediting_body.quote: Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

credential_pegged.quote: Has received the degree of doctor of medicine from a medical school: (1) Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

required.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

experience_source.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

duration.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board

kind.value: progressive postgraduate residency or fellowship training
kind.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, the Collège des médecins du Québec or the College of Family Physicians of Canada

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) examination
exams.notes: One of several acceptable examinations; applicant must pass all parts
exams.quote: Has passed: (1) All parts of the examination given by the National Board of Medical Examiners

exams.name: Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX)
exams.notes: Alternative to NBME; applicant must pass all parts
exams.quote: (2) All parts of the Federation Licensing Examination

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Alternative to NBME; applicant must pass all parts
exams.quote: (3) All parts of the United States Medical Licensing Examination

exams.name: Licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada examination
exams.notes: Alternative examination for candidates seeking licensure
exams.quote: (5) All parts of the examination to become a licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada

exams.name: Oral examination by the Board
exams.notes: Board may require an oral examination in addition to written requirements
exams.quote: an applicant shall appear personally and pass an oral examination, if required by the Board.

exams.name: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) examination
exams.notes: Required only for graduates of foreign medical schools
exams.quote: the standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or a written statement from that Commission that the applicant passed the examination given by the Commission.

required.quote: The Board shall, as a prerequisite for the: ... (c) Biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine, require each holder to submit evidence of compliance with the requirements for continuing education as set forth in regulations adopted by the Board.

period_years.quote: the biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine

value: Risk management in the performance of medical services (optional)
Medical consequences of an act of terrorism involving a weapon of mass destruction (at least 4 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness (at least 2 hours within 2 years after initial licensure; at least 2 hours every 4 years thereafter)
Screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder (at least 2 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion for psychiatrists (at least 2 hours biennially)
HIV stigma, discrimination and unrecognized bias for certain physicians (at least 2 hours within 2 years of providing such services)
Opioid prescribing and substance use disorders (at least 2 hours per licensure period for those with DEA registration)
topical_requirements.quote: Must provide for the completion of a course of instruction, within 2 years after initial licensure, relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism that involves the use of a weapon of mass destruction... Must provide for the completion by a holder of a license to practice medicine of a course of instruction within 2 years after initial licensure that provides at least 2 hours of instruction on evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness

available.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a license to practice medicine by the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid in-effect license in another state/territory, submit proof of passage of an approved examination, meet all statutory requirements except the education/exam requirements of NRS 630.160, and complete additional fitness requirements as required by the Board. Expedited endorsement paths exist for board-certified specialists (NRS 630.1606, 630.1607). Nevada is also a member of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (NRS 629A.100).
requirements.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a license to practice medicine by the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States if: (a) At the time the applicant files an application with the Board, the license is in effect

exists.quote: The purpose of licensing physicians, perfusionists, physician assistants, anesthesiologist assistants and practitioners of respiratory care is to protect the public health and safety and the general welfare of the people of this State.

national_certification.quote: Is currently certified by a specialty board of the American Board of Medical Specialties and who agrees to maintain the certification for the duration of the licensure

national_association.value: American Medical Association / Association of American Medical Colleges (LCME); Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME)
national_association.quote: Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

regulatory_model.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

credential_type.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

is_mandatory.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

title_protection.quote: Hold himself or herself out as a physician assistant or use any other term indicating or implying that he or she is a physician assistant without being licensed by the Board

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, mental or physical condition, or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, a mental or physical condition or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics or any other substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct intended to deceive or violating standards of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct: (1) Which is intended to deceive; (2) Which the Board has determined is a violation of the standards of practice established by regulation of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing controlled substances or dangerous drugs outside of lawful authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing, assisting, or advising injection of liquid silicone except for retinal repair
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, assisting or advising the injection of any substance containing liquid silicone into the human body, except for the use of silicone oil to repair a retinal detachment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services the licensee is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform or which are beyond the scope of his or her training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing experimental procedures or prescribing experimental therapies without informed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, without first obtaining the informed consent of the patient or the patient's family, any procedure or prescribing any therapy which by the current standards of the practice of medicine is experimental.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continual failure to exercise ordinary skill, diligence, or methods of physicians in good standing in the same specialty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continual failure to exercise the skill or diligence or use the methods ordinarily exercised under the same circumstances by physicians in good standing practicing in the same specialty or field.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or failing to file a required record or report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee or applicant knows to be false or failing to file a record or report as required by law or regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report within 30 days any disciplinary action by another state or foreign country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any disciplinary action taken against the licensee or applicant by another state, the Federal Government or a foreign country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report within 30 days any criminal action or conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any criminal action taken or conviction obtained against the licensee or applicant, other than a minor traffic violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine. A plea of nolo contendere is a conviction for the purposes of this subsection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action including revocation or suspension of a license by another state, the Federal Government, or other jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension, modification or limitation of a license to practice any type of medicine, taken by another state, the Federal Government, a foreign country or any other jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner, but only if the malpractice is established by a preponderance of the evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual activity with a current patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging by a practitioner in any sexual activity with a patient who is currently being treated by the practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, or others that interferes with patient care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, members of the families of patients or any other persons if the behavior interferes with patient care or has an adverse impact on the quality of care rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that violates the trust of a patient and exploits the physician-patient relationship for financial or personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging in conduct that violates the trust of a patient and exploits the relationship between the physician and the patient for financial or other personal gain.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, maintaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraud, or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing or attempting to obtain, maintain or renew a license to practice medicine by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation or by any false, misleading, inaccurate or incomplete statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive or misleading manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank prescription form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a blank prescription form.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inappropriate division of fees not disclosed to the patient or not proportionate to services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing a fee between licensees except where the patient is informed of the division of fees and the division of fees is made in proportion to the services personally performed and the responsibility assumed by each licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, employing, or advising any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, employing or advising, directly or indirectly, any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine contrary to the provisions of this chapter or the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate, and complete medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate and complete medical records relating to the diagnosis, treatment and care of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering, or dispensing of Schedule II, III, or IV controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report another person the licensee knows is in violation of the chapter within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report any person the licensee knows, or has reason to know, is in violation of the provisions of this chapter, except for a violation of NRS 630.2672, or the regulations of the Board within 30 days after the date the licensee knows or has reason to know of the violation.

definition_quote.value: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy.
definition_quote.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy.

value: telehealth/electronic/telephonic/fiber optic transfer of patient information
methods_authorized.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy.

drug_authority.value: Physicians are authorized to prescribe, administer, and dispense controlled substances and dangerous drugs as authorized by law. Prescribing controlled substances for intractable pain in accordance with NRS 639.23507 is not grounds for discipline. Physicians may also prescribe investigational drugs/biological products to terminally ill or life-threatened patients under specified conditions.
drug_authority.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

value: Restricted license (teach, research, or practice at medical facility/school)
Limited license (resident physician in graduate program)
license_status_types.quote: the Board may issue: (a) A locum tenens license... (b) A special license... (c) A restricted license... (d) A temporary license... (e) A special purpose license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must submit proof of degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent as determined by the Board, and the standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or a written statement that the applicant passed the ECFMG examination. Proof of degree must be submitted directly by the foreign medical school.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for a license to practice medicine who is a graduate of a foreign medical school shall submit to the Board proof that the applicant has received: (a) The degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent, as determined by the Board; and (b) The standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or a written statement from that Commission that the applicant passed the examination given by the Commission.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

pain_management_education_required.quote: require each physician or physician assistant who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231 to complete at least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids during each period of licensure.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician located at a distant site may use telehealth to write treatment orders or prescriptions for patients in Nevada if the physician holds a valid Nevada license, including a special purpose license. The practice of medicine via telehealth is deemed to occur at the patient's location. The special purpose license allows out-of-state physicians to practice telemedicine in Nevada if they hold a full unrestricted license elsewhere, have had no disciplinary action, and are certified by a specialty board of the ABMS.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: before a provider of health care who is located at a distant site may use telehealth to direct or manage the care or render a diagnosis of a patient who is located at an originating site in this State or write a treatment order or prescription for such a patient, the provider must hold a valid license or certificate to practice his or her profession in this State, including, without limitation, a special purpose license issued pursuant to NRS 630.261.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A special purpose license to a physician who is licensed in another state to perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 of NRS 630.020 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of a patient in this State electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby ratified and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining the Compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant may perform such medical services as the physician assistant is authorized to perform by his or her supervising physician.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe controlled substances limited to the schedules of controlled substances that the supervising physician is authorized to prescribe under state and federal law. The Board and supervising physician shall limit such authority.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: The Board and supervising physician shall limit the authority of a physician assistant to prescribe controlled substances to those schedules of controlled substances that the supervising physician is authorized to prescribe pursuant to state and federal law.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist shall report to the Board: (a) Any action for malpractice against the physician... not later than 45 days after the physician... receives service of a summons and complaint for the action

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: any hospital, clinic or other medical facility licensed in this State, or medical society, shall report to the Board any change in the privileges of a physician, perfusionist, physician assistant, anesthesiologist assistant or practitioner of respiratory care to practice while the physician... is under investigation

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Require the person to participate in a program to correct an alcohol or other substance use disorder or any other impairment

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the Board or committee may order that the physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist undergo a mental or physical examination, an examination testing his or her competence to practice medicine

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: A person may apply to the Board to be licensed as an administrative physician if the person meets all of the statutory requirements for licensure in effect at the time of application except the requirements of paragraph (c) of subsection 2 of NRS 630.160.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A locum tenens license, to be effective not more than 3 months after issuance, to any physician who is licensed and in good standing in another state, who meets the requirements for licensure in this State and who is of good moral character and reputation.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A physician is not subject to disciplinary action for prescribing or recommending an individualized investigational treatment or investigational drug, biological product or device when authorized to do so pursuant to subsection 1.

scope__license_status_types.quote: Any licensee who changes the location of his or her practice of medicine from this State to another state or country, has never engaged in the practice of medicine in this State after licensure or has ceased to engage in the practice of medicine in this State for 12 consecutive months may be placed on inactive status by order of the Board.

A restricted license for a specified period if the Board determines the applicant needs supervision or restriction.
Place the person on probation for a specified period on any of the conditions specified in the order

the surrender of the license or discontinuing the practice of medicine while under investigation by any licensing authority
